hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl tracking-tighter font-black text-[#1A1A1A]
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl tracking-tight font-bold text-[#1A1A1A]

visual_enhancers.borders: Thick 2px solid borders (#1A1A1A) on all cards, inputs, and buttons.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Sharp, neo-brutalist solid shadows: shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1A1A1A]. On hover, shadow shifts to shadow-[2px_2px_0px_#1A1A1A] and the element translates down and right.
visual_enhancers.textures: Keep the background solid but use paper-like off-white (#FDFBF7) to reduce eye strain.
visual_enhancers.radii: Small rounded corners (rounded-md or 6px) to maintain a structured yet friendly feel.

components.cards: White surface, 2px solid black border, 4px solid black drop shadow. No soft blur shadows.
components.buttons: Pill-shaped or slightly rounded. Primary button uses Butter Yellow (#FFE37E) with black text and border. Hover state translates down and right, shadow reduces.
components.tabs: Neo-brutalist active tab uses a pastel background (e.g., Pale mint #A7E8D0) with a heavy bottom border or full border + shadow.
components.drag_drop_zone: Dashed 2px black border with pastel background tint (#F9FAFB or very light mint). Highly visible drop text.
components.inputs: Solid white background, 2px black border, focus state uses an accent color (lavender #D0C9FF) ring or thick border.
components.list_items: Draggable queue items use crisp borders and a drag handle icon (six dots). Active dragged item has a heavier shadow.

layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento-style layout for the dashboard. A left sidebar for the study queue (lessons list), and a large main content area for the tabbed view (PDF, Notes, Links).
layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. p-6 or p-8 inside main containers. gap-6 or gap-8 between grid items.
layouts.alignment: Left-aligned content for optimal reading focus. Never center paragraph text.

motion.interactions: Hover states on cards and buttons: translate-x-[2px] translate-y-[2px] and shadow reduces to [2px_2px_0px_#1A1A1A].
motion.transitions: Use specific properties: transition-transform duration-200, transition-shadow duration-200. Do NOT use 'transition-all'.

accessibility.contrast: Black text on pastel backgrounds provides high contrast. Ensure placeholder text in inputs meets 4.5:1 ratio.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements MUST have `data-testid` attribute.

media.icons: Phosphor Icons (Duotone or Bold) for a playful, distinct look. Installation: `yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`

image_urls.description: Abstract pastel geometric shapes, perfect for the login screen side panel.
A student focusing at a desk, ideal for empty states when no PDF is uploaded.

instructions_to_main_agent: Implement auth screens (Login/Register) using the geometry pastel image as a side panel.
Implement a Dashboard with a drag-and-drop Sidebar for the study queue ('Ders Sırası').
In the main area, implement a Tabbed view ('PDFler', 'Linkler', 'Notlar').
For the PDF tab, create a drag-and-drop upload zone and a list/thumbnail view of uploaded PDFs.
For the Links tab, create a form to save URL, Title, and Description, and display saved links in neo-brutalist cards.
Ensure 'Otomatik Kaydedildi' (Auto-saved) indicator is visible, perhaps in the header next to user profile.
DO NOT use generic centered layouts. Use a clear sidebar + main content structure.
Apply the neo-brutalist shadow classes: `shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1A1A1A]` for cards.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: You MUST NOT apply universal transition. Eg: `transition: all`. This results in breaking transforms. Always add transitions for specific interactive elements like button, input excluding transforms
You MUST NOT center align the app container, ie do not add `.App { text-align: center; }` in the css file. This disrupts the human natural reading flow of text
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters like 🤖🧠💭💡🔮🎯 etc for icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations. Static = dead.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom cursors, selection states, and loading animations: separates good from extraordinary.
Main agent relies on these image URLs. Missing categories (especially sponsor logos) = main agent will use placeholder text which is FORBIDDEN
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable
Create a clean code structure keeping components modular.
